idea: haus is an unbiased, plain-language AI home-finance advisor for first-time buyers worldwide. A user enters their income, savings, city/country, and asks a question like 'is it the right time to buy?'; haus replies with a clear verdict, an affordable price range, an EMI/mortgage simulation, explained jargon, and concrete next steps in their local currency and loan context so they feel ready to decide.
target_user: First-time homebuyers in Bangalore aged 22-32, young working professionals navigating their first major property/loan decision with no trusted guidance (v1 launch market; global is the long-term vision)
